CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.network_generation_line_points(p_member uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(root_id uuid, gp numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with recursive d(id,root_id,depth,path) as (
  select m.user_id,m.user_id,1,array[p_member,m.user_id] from public.member_profiles m where m.sponsor_id=p_member
  union all select m.user_id,d.root_id,d.depth+1,d.path||m.user_id
  from d join public.member_profiles m on m.sponsor_id=d.id
  where d.depth<private.network_generation_limit() and not m.user_id=any(d.path)
 )
 select d.root_id,coalesce(sum(a.gp),0)::numeric
 from d left join public.package_activations a on a.member_id=d.id and a.status='approved'
  and d.depth>=2 and coalesce(a.activated_at,a.requested_at)>private.financial_reset_at()
 group by d.root_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refresh_team_manager_qualification(p_member uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare m jsonb;inserted boolean:=false;
begin m:=private.team_manager_metrics(p_member);if coalesce((m->>'qualified_now')::boolean,false) then
 insert into private.team_manager_qualifications(member_id,rule_version,qualification_snapshot) values(p_member,(m->'rules'->>'version')::integer,m) on conflict(member_id) do nothing;inserted:=found;
 insert into private.team_manager_balances(member_id) values(p_member) on conflict do nothing;end if;return inserted;end$function$
